hero.title: Terraform Authoring and Operations Advanced
hero.description: Demonstrate your production-level Terraform expertise in this intensive, lab-based exam. Choose either the AWS or Azure version of the exam to earn the same credential.

announcement.text: You can take two free exams with the purchase of a HashiConf at TechXchange ticket.

whoShouldTakeExam.title: Who should take this exam
whoShouldTakeExam.description: You should take the Terraform Authoring & Operations Advanced exam if you have production-tested Terraform expertise in both configuration authoring and Terraform workflows. Demonstrate your skills implementing and authoring Terraform modules, developing dynamic HCL configuration, and establishing scalable, collaborative workflows. Earn the same certification using either the AWS or Azure provider with Terraform.

details.name: Price
details.value: $295 USD, plus locally applicable taxes and fees. Free retake included.

prerequisites.title: Prerequisites
prereqs: Terraform Associate certification (strongly recommend, or equivalent experience required)
Linux skills, such as the ability to list and edit files via command terminal
Familiarity with YAML, JSON, HCL, and CSV formats
Understanding of the networking stack and networking protocols, including TCP/IP and UDP
Advanced configuration authoring and a deep understanding of Terraform workflows
prerequisites.bottomDescription: Experience with Terraform in a production setting is necessary.

renewCertifications.title: Renew Your Certification
renewCertifications.description: Understand your recertification options. Start by finding the scenario that applies to you and then evaluate your options. Know which exam version you passed by the 3-digit code on your credentials (badge and certificate).

linkWithImage.title: Visit our knowledge base
linkWithImage.description: Review and follow the rules and requirements for taking exams before you register for an exam appointment. You are responsible for following the identification, system, and physical space requirements.

relatedCertsFooter.title: Related Certifications
relatedCertsFooter.description: Expand your expertise with certifications that build on related skills and technologies. Explore the next step in your learning journey.
